# Documentation sync

CI checks page shape and links (`python3 tool/check-docs.py`) and that a code change carries a CHANGELOG entry; it does not check that the text is still true.

## Surface to docs

| Code surface | Update |
|---|---|
| New or changed facade, or a method on one | `doc/architecture/facades.md` and the page of its subsystem, `skills/magic-framework/references/facades-api.md`, CHANGELOG |
| New config domain, base class or core provider | `doc/getting-started/configuration.md`, `assets/stubs/` and `install.yaml`, the skill reference for that subsystem, CHANGELOG |
| New or changed `make:*` generator | `doc/packages/magic-cli.md`, `skills/magic-framework/references/cli-commands.md` and `templates.md`, CHANGELOG |
| Behaviour of an existing API (signature, default, thrown error) | its `doc/**` page and Gotchas row, the skill reference, CHANGELOG `Changed`, flagged BREAKING when callers must change |
| A layer that moved to a plugin, or a new plugin pointer | the page that mentioned it, a pointer to the plugin's own page (never the plugin API inline), CHANGELOG |
| New doc page | an `llms.txt` line, the section order in the docs site config (site repo, not here) |

## Formats

- `CHANGELOG.md`: Keep a Changelog 1.1.0. New bullets go under `## [Unreleased]` in BREAKING, Added, Changed, Removed, Fixed or Improvements, with a bold lead sentence, then the why. A release promotes it to `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `README.md`: front page; install, a taste, the doc map. Link pages by site URL, no counts, no release-status wording.
- `llms.txt`: H1 `# magic`, a `>` summary, `**Stack**`, `**Setup**`, `## API`, `## Platforms`, `## Rules for agents`, `## Docs`, `## Links`. `## Docs` takes one line per page under `https://anilcancakir.com/magic/docs/`.
- `doc/`: `doc/<section>/<page>.md`, lowercase slugs, one `#` heading first, then a one-sentence lead, a bare-list ToC, `<a name="slug"></a>` before every `##`, a `## Gotchas` table on basics pages and `## Related Documentation` last, with relative `.md` links between pages. Plugin APIs are documented in the plugin's repo, not here.
- `skills/magic-framework/`: `SKILL.md` (frontmatter `name`, a single-line quoted `description`, `version`, a single-line quoted `when_to_use`) plus `references/` for long tables. The body stamp `<!-- magic X.Y.Z |` tracks the package version and is checked by `publish.yml`.
